newsitem.title: CUBA: Cuban passenger plane plunges into sea.
newsitem.headline: Cuban passenger plane plunges into sea.

text.p: A Cuban plane carrying 39 passengers plunged into the sea on Friday night shortly after take-off from the eastern city of Santiago de Cuba on a flight to Havana, a Havana airport official said.
The official, contacted at the information section at Havana airport, said there was no word yet on whether there had been any deaths. But she added that rescue work was currently underway.
The airport official said there were foreigners on board the plane, but did not say how many or give any indication of their nationality.
The official said there were 39 passengers on the plane, but she did not say how many crew were on board the Cubana de Aviacion flight, a scheduled trip from Cuba's second city to the capital.
She said the plane crashed three minutes after take-off from Santiago de Cuba, which is about 520 miles (850 km) southeast of Havana. The official said she had no further details for the moment.
